ranks: Need-keys Phase 2: cards freed by the cost:loyalty-x, cost and decision families through effect:random-card-from-hand (two agents of 75 and 74 cards, one blind reviewer)

authored.name: Blex, Vexing Pest // Search for Blex
Profane Procession // Tomb of the Dusk Rose
Throne of the Grim Captain // The Grim Captain

blocked.name: Winter, Cynical Opportunist
blocked.why: The zone choice's `variety` rule exists in zone-choice-together.ts, but no definition field reaches it: SearchTogether has no form for it, so 'any number of cards with four or more card types among them' can't be said on a choice.

blocked.name: Chandra, Hope's Beacon
blocked.why: 'You may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among those exiled cards' is one spell in total until the end of your next turn; impulse-exile has all of them or oncePerTurn, and the ruling lets an Adventure's spell half qualify on a creature card.

blocked.name: Huatli, Warrior Poet
blocked.why: An activated ability's divided has no x: true, and a total of 'x' is read at X 0 in the offer whenever X varies, capping the group at no targets.

blocked.name: Meteor Shower
blocked.why: 'X plus 1' divided: the CardDefinition.divided doc says such a total isn't offered right yet.

blocked.name: Avacyn's Judgment
blocked.why: The total is 2, or X if the madness cost was paid: the same offer problem.

blocked.name: Shatterskull Smashing // Shatterskull, the Hammer Pass
blocked.why: 'Twice X if X is 6 or more' must be the total being divided (its ruling): the same offer problem.

blocked.name: Pollen Remedy
blocked.why: The kicker takes targets and effect but no divided, and the offer's total is read before kicked is known.

blocked.name: Jeska, Thrice Reborn
blocked.why: A one-shot 'until your next turn' multiplier on one target creature with 'your opponents' fixed to Jeska's controller; a granted would-deal-damage static reads the creature's controller, wrong on an opponent's creature.

blocked.name: Kasmina, Enigma Sage
blocked.why: The −8 searches for 'shares a color with this planeswalker', the activating walker when the ability is granted (ruling); sharesColorWithTarget takes only a target slot.

blocked.name: Fatal Lore
blocked.why: castModal.chosenBy modes may not take targets, and the mode needs 'up to two target creatures that player controls' chosen after it.

blocked.name: Mausoleum Turnkey
blocked.why: targetsChosenBy has trigger-player, active-player and trigger-object-controller only; opponentChoosesTargets isn't on triggers.

blocked.name: Mogg Assassin
blocked.why: 'That opponent' must control the first target; otherChooser accepts any opponent, wrong past two players.

blocked.name: Flickerform
blocked.why: Exiles the creature and all its Auras together; at the end step the card returns first, then the Auras attached to it under their owners' control, and nothing returns for a token.

blocked.name: Next of Kin
blocked.why: One choice across hand and command zone: look-and-choose takes one zone, and hand-or-graveyard doesn't cover the command zone.

blocked.name: Bone Shaman
blocked.why: The gained ability is a static applying as damage is dealt and to damage dealt earlier in the turn; prohibit is one-shot and a trigger would resolve after state-based actions.

blocked.name: Whippoorwill
blocked.why: Damage to that creature this turn can't be prevented or dealt instead to another permanent or player; damage-cant-be-prevented is global, and nothing stops redirection.

blocked.name: Spinerock Tyrant
blocked.why: 'Those spells gain wither' includes the original; gains reaches only the copy.

blocked.name: Cherished Hatchling
blocked.why: grant-spells-this-turn's triggered doesn't stay on the permanent, so the fight never triggered (written and tested, then removed).

blocked.name: Fishing Pole
blocked.why: A granted cost of 'Tap Fishing Pole': sacrifice and unattach have a 'granter' form, tapping doesn't.

blocked.name: Hold for Ransom
blocked.why: 'Hold for Ransom's controller draws a card' needs a player ref for the granter's controller; neither EffectPlayerRef nor PlayerScope has one.

blocked.name: Selective Adaptation
blocked.why: One card per keyword, then one of those onto the battlefield and the rest to hand: oneEach has one destination, and secondPick doesn't share the set.

blocked.name: Wheel of Potential
blocked.why: A play permission on cards a resolution exiled from hands, lasting until the end of your next turn; allow-cast-from-exile and ExilePermission offer this turn or while exiled.

blocked.name: Ulamog's Despoiler
blocked.why: AsEntersAction can exile or return, but can't put opponents' exiled cards into graveyards with counters riding on it.

blocked.name: Conundrum Sphinx
blocked.why: Every player names a card, then all reveal at once; a for-each-player would show each reveal before the next player names.

blocked.name: Sphinx Ambassador
blocked.why: choose-card-name's chooser is only a target slot, so the damaged player can't name while 'you' keeps the may-put.

blocked.name: Amzu, Swarm's Hunger
blocked.why: An aggregate can't read a leaves-graveyard batch once the cards are in a hand or library.

blocked.name: Coram, the Undertaker
blocked.why: Static castFromGraveyard reads only your own graveyard with no 'a land and a spell' allowance; whose exists only on the resolved player-effect.

blocked.name: Animate Dead
blocked.why: An Aura whose enchant is a graveyard card, which then swaps to the creature it returned.

blocked.name: Necromancy
blocked.why: A non-Aura becoming an Aura with 'enchant creature put onto the battlefield with this'.

blocked.name: Gilgamesh, Master-at-Arms
blocked.why: A reflexive trigger's about carries one object, not the set put this way, and the ruling needs a real reflexive ability ordered against job select.

blocked.name: Spoils of War
blocked.why: X fixed to an exact count as cast, of an opponent's graveyard: maxX is only a ceiling, and the ruling says exactly.

blocked.name: Stumpsquall Hydra
blocked.why: 'Among it and any number': counters-distributed lets the player choose no recipients and lose the counters, and can't require the source.

blocked.name: Dire Flail // Dire Blunderbuss
blocked.why: 'An artifact other than Dire Blunderbuss' needs a filter excluding the granter; notName would also wrongly exclude a second copy.

blocked.name: Hellish Rebuke
blocked.why: The granted trigger must fire only on damage to the player who cast the spell; deals-damage's to can't name that player, which matters in multiplayer.

blocked.name: The Darkness Crystal
blocked.why: The would-be-put-into-graveyard exile can't link to the source, so 'exiled with' finds nothing.

blocked.name: Kamahl's Will
blocked.why: With both modes chosen, the first mode's any-number group of lands comes before the second mode's target creature; a group must be its list's last slot, and swapping the modes would deal the damage before the lands animate.

blocked.name: Delaying Shield
blocked.why: Its ruling: the damage is replaced, not prevented, so it replaces damage that can't be prevented; would-deal-damage's prevent: true lets unpreventable damage through.

blocked.name: Angrath, Minotaur Pirate
blocked.why: The −11's rulings subtract a negative-power creature from the total, and a survivor's power counts as it is now: an aggregate sum clamps at 0 on its own, so a surviving negative-power creature doesn't reduce the destroyed creatures' power.

blocked.name: Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel
blocked.why: 'You may cast the discarded card' must also reach a card madness exiled as it was discarded; cast-now with from: graveyard and thisWay: discarded doesn't offer it.
